## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see in BuilderOS.

## 💡 Problem Statement / User Value
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:
- **Problem:** "I'm always frustrated when..."
- **Target User:** Product Manager, Fullstack Developer, System Architect, etc.
- **Value Proposition:** How this improves the BuilderOS experience.

## 🎨 Proposed Solution & UX Design
Describe how you envision the feature working:
- Component / View affected (e.g. `Roadmaps`, `Architecture Planner`, `AI Chat Assistant`, `Task Kanban`)
- User Interaction Flow
- UI/UX mockups or wireframes (if any)

## 🛠️ Alternative Approaches
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, API integrations, or database schema additions relevant to this request.
